content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Kerala Public Service Commission has officially released Category No. 151/2026 TO 161/2026 for recruitment to 74 Peon/Watchman, Draftsman and More posts. The notification includes complete details, district-wise vacancies, eligibility, physical standards, medical certificate format, age limit, selection process, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full notification and its annexures before applying online. The notification PDF is available on the official Kerala PSC website. content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is required for this post. Candidates can apply free of cost through the official KPSC One Time Registration portal at www.keralapsc.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will be conducted as per the rules and regulations of Travancore Titanium Products Ltd. If a Written / OMR / Online Test is conducted as part of the selection, only candidates possessing the requisite qualifications will be allowed to appear. Candidates will be advised from the Ranked List prepared in the order of merit. The Ranked List will remain in force for a minimum period of one year and a maximum period of three years . Kerala PSC reserves the right to cancel the advice for appointment of any candidate if any mistake is found later. Final selection is subject to verification of original documents and medical fitness.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Kerala PSC has announced a total of 74 vacancies for Peon/Watchman, Draftsman, Forest Boat Driver, Higher Secondary School Teacher, Police Constable Driver and other posts.

faq.question: Q2. What are the Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Category Numbers?
faq.answer: The recruitment notifications have been released under Category No. 151/2026 to 161/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 04 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. When did the Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process started on 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualification varies by post and includes Standard VI, SSLC, Plus Two, Diploma, Bachelor's/Professional qualifications and Master's Degree with B.Ed, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit varies according to the post and generally ranges from 18 to 50 years. Candidates should check the respective notification for the exact age criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post. The available pay scales range from ₹24,500–42,900 to ₹55,200–1,15,300, depending on the position.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. There is no application fee for candidates applying for these Kerala PSC posts.
